place.name: Binnenhof
place.description: The Binnenhof (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈbɪnə(n)ˌɦɔf] ; English: Inner Court) is a complex of buildings in the city centre of The Hague, Netherlands, next to the Hofvijver (Court Pond). It houses the meeting place of both houses of the States General of the Netherlands, as well as the Ministry of General Affairs and the office of the prime minister of the Netherlands.
